manifest.format: Required. Always the text `%PACK_FORMAT%`: it says the file is a v2 pack manifest.
manifest.formatVersion: Required. Always the number `%PACK_FORMAT_VERSION%`. Any other value is refused with `pack.FORMAT_VERSION`.
manifest.id: Required. The pack's id: 1 to %PACK_ID_CHARS_ADAPTATION% characters of lower-case `a-z`, `0-9`, dots and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, with no `..`. It may not begin with `mod.`, `model.` or `texture.`: those prefixes are kept for the earlier formats.
manifest.version: Required. The pack's version, a semantic version such as `1.0.0` (a pre-release such as `1.0.0-beta.1` is allowed here, but not by Thunderstore).
manifest.name: Required. The pack's display name: 1 to %PACK_NAME_CHARS_ADAPTATION% printable ASCII characters.
manifest.description: Optional. A short description: up to %PACK_DESCRIPTION_CHARS_ADAPTATION% printable ASCII characters. It is part of the pack's identity hash, so changing it changes the pack's hash.
manifest.target: Required. The disc revision the pack is for. It must be exactly the build's target (see `PACK_TARGET_US` below); an earlier spelling is refused and the finding names the canonical one.
manifest.contract: Required. A version range, such as `^%RULES_PACK_CONTRACT_FLOOR%`, that the build's engine contract version (`ENGINE_CONTRACT_VERSION`) must satisfy. Ranges take `*`, `=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `^` and `~`, sets separated by spaces and alternatives by `||`. A pack of kind `rules` must not admit any engine before `%RULES_PACK_CONTRACT_FLOOR%`.
manifest.kinds: Required. A list naming each of `content`, `rules` and `system` at most once, and at least one of them: what the pack contains.
manifest.sides: Required. One of `client`, `server` or `both`. The check only tests that it is one of the three; nothing else in the contract reads it. The earlier formats are read as `client`.
manifest.dependencies: Required, empty when there are none. A list of at most %PACK_DEPENDENCIES_ADAPTATION% entries, each either `{id, range}` (another pack, by its id and a version range) or `{archive, sha256}` (one of your own disc archives, by its path and SHA-256). The same id or archive may not appear twice, and a pack may not depend on itself.
manifest.files: Required, at least one row. Every member of the pack except the manifest itself, one row each (see the `files` row below). A file in the zip that is not listed is refused, apart from Thunderstore's root files beside the manifest.
manifest.intents: Required. A list of at most %PACK_INTENTS_ADAPTATION% entries, each `{kind, files}`: which members a change is declared to be, and what kind of change it is. Every member must be named by at least one intent.
manifest.handlers: Optional. A list of at most %PACK_HANDLERS_ADAPTATION% claims on handler slots the engine owns (see the `handlers` claim below). No pack code runs: a claim only names a handler the engine already has.

fileRow.path: The member's path inside the pack: relative, forward slashes, at most %PACK_PATH_CHARS_ADAPTATION% characters and %PACK_PATH_DEPTH_ADAPTATION% folders deep, with no `..`, drive, leading slash, colon, percent sign, control character, hidden (dot-led) or reserved segment. It may not be `%PACK_MANIFEST_FILE%` or one of Thunderstore's root files.
fileRow.sha256: The SHA-256 of the member's bytes, as 64 lower-case hex digits. The check hashes the member and refuses it when the hash differs.
fileRow.size: The member's size in bytes, a whole number of 0 or more. The check compares it with the stored size before reading any bytes.
fileRow.role: What the member is: one of the roles below. The path's file type must be one the role allows.

handlerClaim.slot: The engine-owned slot the pack claims, a dotted lower-case name of at most 64 characters such as `visual.post`. A pack claims a slot at most once.
handlerClaim.handler: The engine handler the pack asks for on that slot, a dotted lower-case name of at most 64 characters. It must be one the build offers for that slot, or the claim is refused with `pack.HANDLER_UNKNOWN`.
handlerClaim.actions: Optional. A list of at most %PACK_HANDLER_ACTIONS_ADAPTATION% distinct dotted lower-case action names the claim uses; each must be one the handler offers.
handlerClaim.options: Optional. A plain JSON object handed to the handler: at most %PACK_HANDLER_OPTIONS_BYTES_ADAPTATION% bytes of JSON, nested at most %PACK_HANDLER_OPTIONS_DEPTH_ADAPTATION% deep, finite numbers only, and no `__proto__`, `constructor` or `prototype` key. The contract checks only this shape; the handler checks what is in it.

kinds.content: Content: assets and maps (models, textures, sounds, collision, data, an authored map). The earlier formats are read as `content` packs. The check sets no rule of its own on this kind.
kinds.rules: Declarative rules for a game mode, in `rules`-role JSON members: data only, never code. A `rules` pack's `contract` must start at `%RULES_PACK_CONTRACT_FLOOR%` or above, and its members' capabilities must agree with its `handlers` claims.
kinds.system: Engine systems: changes made through claims on engine-owned handler slots (the one such slot today is the full-screen picture pass `visual.post`). The check sets no rule of its own on this kind.

legacyKinds.mod: An `s2u-mod` v1 data-override mod. It is read as the pack `mod.` plus its id, its files as role `data` under a `gameplay-value` intent; a version that is not a semantic version is kept as `0.0.0+legacy.` plus the old version.
legacyKinds.model: The model pack (glTF models in place of the game's meshes). It is read as `model.current` version `1.0.0`, its files as role `mesh` under a `cosmetic` intent.
legacyKinds.texture: A texture pack for one map. It is read as `texture.` plus the map's name, version `1.0.0`, its files as role `texture` under a `cosmetic` intent with their own SHA-256 and sizes, and the map archive as a disc archive dependency when the pack records the archive's SHA-256.

sides.client: The value `client`. The check accepts it; the contract gives it no further rule.
sides.server: The value `server`. The check accepts it; the contract gives it no further rule.
sides.both: The value `both`. The check accepts it; the contract gives it no further rule.

roles.collision: Collision data, as JSON or a glTF binary model.
roles.gameplay: A JSON member of gameplay values.
roles.rules: A JSON rules member (a rules spec). It is bounded by `PACK_RULES_MEMBER_BYTES_ADAPTATION`, read whole once, and must be a UTF-8 JSON object whose `capabilities`, when present, is a list of `{slot, handler, actions?}`.
roles.system: A JSON member for a system claim.
roles.data: Any other data; any file type.
roles.legacy-manifest: An earlier format's own manifest, kept as a member when the contract reads an earlier pack.

intents.cosmetic: The members change only how the game looks or sounds. A `collision`, `gameplay` or `rules` member cannot be covered by `cosmetic` alone.
intents.gameplay-value: The members change values the game already has.
intents.new-behaviour: The members add behaviour the game does not have.

values.PACK_MANIFEST_FILE: The manifest's file name at the pack's root.
values.ENGINE_CONTRACT_VERSION: The engine contract version this build publishes; a pack's `contract` range must include it.
values.PACK_TARGET_US: The disc revision this build targets (the US disc's product code); a pack's `target` must be exactly this.
values.RULES_PACK_CONTRACT_FLOOR: The first engine contract with the rules vocabulary. A `rules` pack's `contract` must start at it or above in every `||` alternative; it stays the same when the build's contract moves on.
values.THUNDERSTORE_TEAM_PLACEHOLDER: A stand-in for the Thunderstore team packs would publish under, used in exported dependency pins. It is not a real team: the team is not named yet.

targetAliases.socom2-us-r0001: The `s2u-mod` v1 spelling of the target. Only the `mod` adapter accepts it; in a v2 manifest it is refused and the finding names the canonical target.

bounds.PACK_BYTES_ADAPTATION: All members together, by their sizes in the manifest (`pack.TOO_LARGE`). The stored files are first held to this plus the manifest's own bound.
bounds.PACK_FILES_ADAPTATION: Files in the pack, and rows in `files` (`pack.TOO_MANY_FILES`).
bounds.PACK_HANDLER_OPTIONS_BYTES_ADAPTATION: Bytes of one claim's `options` written as JSON (`pack.FIELD_INVALID`).
bounds.PACK_HANDLER_OPTIONS_DEPTH_ADAPTATION: How deep one claim's `options` nest: the options object is level 1, an object or list inside it level 2 (`pack.FIELD_INVALID`).
bounds.PACK_ID_CHARS_ADAPTATION: Characters in `id`, not counting an earlier format's prefix (`pack.FIELD_INVALID`).
bounds.PACK_MANIFEST_BYTES_ADAPTATION: The size of `s2u-pack.json` (`pack.MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE`), and of Thunderstore's `manifest.json` when the store checker reads it.
bounds.PACK_MEMBER_BYTES_ADAPTATION: One member, other than a `rules` member (`pack.MEMBER_TOO_LARGE`).
bounds.PACK_RULES_MEMBER_BYTES_ADAPTATION: One `rules` member, which is read whole (`pack.MEMBER_TOO_LARGE`). It is the manifest's bound.

storeRules.required: The files a Thunderstore package must hold at its root (not in a folder).
storeRules.optional: The root file a Thunderstore package may also hold.
storeRules.manifestKeys: The keys of Thunderstore's `manifest.json`, in the order the export writes them.
storeRules.name: The store name: letters, digits and underscores, at most %THUNDERSTORE_PACKAGE_RULES.name.maxChars% characters. Our id becomes it with each `.` and `-` written as `_`.
storeRules.versionNumber: The store version: strictly Major.Minor.Patch, with no pre-release or build part.
storeRules.description: The store description's length in characters. The export never cuts a longer one; it refuses it.
storeRules.websiteUrl: The store `website_url`: empty, or an http or https address. This rule is ours, not Thunderstore's; a pack manifest cannot carry an address, so the export takes it as an option.
storeRules.dependency: One store dependency: `Team-Name-x.y.z`, an exact version. The export pins each `{id, range}` dependency to the highest release it is given inside the range.
storeRules.icon: The size `icon.png` must be, in pixels. Only the PNG header is read.

packCodes.pack.MANIFEST_MISSING: The pack has no `s2u-pack.json` and is not being read through an earlier format's loader.
packCodes.pack.MANIFEST_INVALID: `s2u-pack.json` is not UTF-8 JSON, or is not a JSON object.
packCodes.pack.LEGACY_INVALID: An earlier format's manifest is not in that format's shape, or its own path is not a valid member path.
packCodes.pack.FIELD_UNKNOWN: The manifest, or a `files` row, has a field the format does not list.
packCodes.pack.FIELD_INVALID: A field's value breaks its rule: the wrong type, out of its bounds, not one of its allowed values, or a target written in an earlier spelling. Also a stored member whose size is not a byte count.
packCodes.pack.TARGET_MISMATCH: The pack's `target` is not the build's disc revision.
packCodes.pack.CONTRACT_MISMATCH: The build's engine contract version is outside the pack's `contract` range.
packCodes.pack.PATH_INVALID: A path is empty, uses backslashes, is too long or too deep, or has a control character, colon, percent sign, or an empty, hidden, reserved or unsafe segment.
packCodes.pack.PATH_ESCAPE: A path is absolute, names a drive, or leaves the pack with `..`.
packCodes.pack.PATH_COLLISION: Two files or rows are the same path once Unicode-normalised and compared without case.
packCodes.pack.EXTERNAL_URI: A path is a URI, or a manifest text holds an address such as `https://` or begins with `data:`, `javascript:`, `file:` or a similar scheme. Every byte comes from the pack or your own disc.
packCodes.pack.TOO_MANY_FILES: The pack holds, or `files` lists, more than `PACK_FILES_ADAPTATION` members.
packCodes.pack.TOO_LARGE: The members' sizes in the manifest add up to more than `PACK_BYTES_ADAPTATION`, or the stored files add up to more than that plus `PACK_MANIFEST_BYTES_ADAPTATION`.
packCodes.pack.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: `dependencies`, `intents` or `handlers` has more entries than its bound.
packCodes.pack.MEMBER_TOO_LARGE: One member is over its bound (`PACK_MEMBER_BYTES_ADAPTATION`, or `PACK_RULES_MEMBER_BYTES_ADAPTATION` for a `rules` member).
packCodes.pack.MEMBER_INFLATED: A member has more bytes than its declared size.
packCodes.pack.MEMBER_TRUNCATED: A member has fewer bytes than its declared size.
packCodes.pack.MEMBER_MISSING: A listed member is not in the pack.
packCodes.pack.MEMBER_HASH_MISMATCH: A member's bytes do not match the `sha256` its row names.
packCodes.pack.MEMBER_UNLISTED: A file in the pack is not listed in `files`.
packCodes.pack.ROLE_MISMATCH: A member's file type is not one its role allows.
packCodes.pack.INTENT_MISMATCH: A `collision`, `gameplay` or `rules` member is covered only by a `cosmetic` intent.
packCodes.pack.DUPLICATE_ID: `dependencies` names the same pack or archive twice.
packCodes.pack.DEPENDENCY_MISSING: No available pack with that id is inside the range, or the named disc archive is not present.
packCodes.pack.DEPENDENCY_ARCHIVE_MISMATCH: The disc archive is present but its SHA-256 is not the one the pack names.
packCodes.pack.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: The pack depends on itself, directly or through the available packs.
packCodes.pack.HANDLER_CONFLICT: Two claims in the pack are on one slot, or the slot is held by another pack and only one pack may hold it.
packCodes.pack.HANDLER_UNKNOWN: The build offers no such handler for that slot.
packCodes.pack.ACTION_UNKNOWN: The claimed handler has no such action.
packCodes.pack.STORE_FILE: A `files` row names one of Thunderstore's root files. Leave them out of `files`: they sit at the pack's root outside its identity.
packCodes.pack.CONTRACT_FLOOR: A `rules` pack's `contract` admits an engine before `RULES_PACK_CONTRACT_FLOOR`.
packCodes.pack.RULES_MEMBER_INVALID: A `rules` member is not a UTF-8 JSON object, or its `capabilities` is not a list of `{slot, handler, actions?}`.
packCodes.pack.CAPABILITY_MISMATCH: A `rules` member's capabilities and the manifest's `handlers` claims disagree: a capability with no matching claim or action, or a claim on a `behaviour.` slot that no rules member names.
packCodes.pack.CHECK_SKIPPED: A note, not an error: a check could not run because the build gave it nothing to check against (the available packs, your disc archives or the handler list). The report is then incomplete, never a pass.

storeCodes.store.TEAM_INVALID: The team name is not 1 to %THUNDERSTORE_PACKAGE_RULES.name.maxChars% letters, digits and underscores.
storeCodes.store.NAME_INVALID: The pack's id has no store name.
storeCodes.store.NAME_COLLISION: Two ids, the pack's own or ones it depends on, would become the same store name. Neither is renamed: one pack has to change its id.
storeCodes.store.VERSION_INVALID: The pack's version is not strictly Major.Minor.Patch (a pre-release or build part).
storeCodes.store.DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG: The store description is over %THUNDERSTORE_PACKAGE_RULES.description.maxChars% characters.
storeCodes.store.WEBSITE_INVALID: The `website_url` given is neither empty nor an http or https address.
storeCodes.store.DEPENDENCY_UNRESOLVED: No release of a dependency inside its range was given to pin.
storeCodes.store.ARCHIVE_DEPENDENCY: A note, not an error: a disc archive dependency has no store form and stays in `s2u-pack.json`.
storeCodes.store.FILE_MISSING: A required root file is not at the package's root.
storeCodes.store.MANIFEST_INVALID: The store `manifest.json` is not a UTF-8 JSON object within the manifest bound, or one of its keys breaks its rule.
storeCodes.store.MANIFEST_MISMATCH: The store manifest's name or version is not the pack's own.
storeCodes.store.ICON_INVALID: `icon.png` is not a PNG of the required size.
